decisions.reason: As an established aloe vera facial-care line that is very close to the firm's existing natural skincare knowledge and was already retained after review, it fits the firm's absorptive capacity well and is more likely to be improved than withdrawn.

Although less prominently presented so far, the facial cleansing oil is still closely related to the firm's core formulation and production know-how, so management would usually keep it for further learning and refinement unless sales prove clearly weak.
